releases.name: Titanium Profiles
releases.notes:
- Profile cards, redrawn: the profile color runs along the left edge, which is also the grip to reorder, and an open profile has its border in that color. The state fits in one line, today's Claude Code cost is the main figure with the last 7 days beside it, and the details open in a dialog from the ⋯ menu.
- Profile icon: a circle filled with the profile color, with its state as a ring around it. While dragging, a bar shows where the profile will land.
- Tray menu, regrouped: Open Titanium Profiles first, then the profiles under a title that counts them, each with its global shortcut, then Start all, Settings…, Check for Updates… and Quit. On macOS the menu bar icon shows how many profiles are running (2/5), which can be switched off in Settings › General; on Windows a click on the icon opens the window and the right button the menu.
- Settings in five tabs (General, Profiles, Statistics, Data, Updates), laid out like the settings of a Mac app.
- The G&G Technologies logo at the bottom of the sidebar opens the maker's site.
- Fixed: on macOS 27 and later the tray menu shows again the colored dot of each profile's state.

releases.name: Titanium Profiles
releases.notes:
- Updates: a check that fails after a version was verified keeps Show in Finder instead of offering Download again; after "a newer version is already installed", the same update is no longer offered again; a downloaded update kept across a restart is checked again in full and used, and one cut short or no longer offered is deleted; Install and Relaunch and Download act on the version shown, even while an automatic check runs.
- Logs: choosing another log shows "Loading…" instead of the previous log under the new name; a rotation while paused no longer mixes entries of the old and the new file; two MCP server logs whose names differ only by a final number are no longer mixed up; logs -f no longer loses entries after a rotation.
- Moving a removed profile's data to the Trash says what went and what stayed when it fails partway, keeps a profile folder that is a link, and takes the whole profile folder after the profiles folder was changed. A Claude Code folder picked by hand next to a profile's data now shows as Custom, and is kept.
- Also fixed: Diagnostics says again which value is out of range; a profile that cannot be created leaves no empty folders; two profiles started at the same moment both keep their last start; screen readers hear the count of each new log filter; smaller fixes in Settings, the dashboard and Statistics.

releases.name: Titanium Profiles
releases.notes:
- Updates: the app checks the G&G download site once a day (on by default, can be turned off in Settings › Updates), and on request with Check for Updates… in Settings, the tray menu and the macOS application menu. On macOS, Install and Relaunch downloads the signed and notarized disk image, verifies it and replaces the app in place; on Windows the app opens the release page. The check sends only the app's name and version.
- One copy of the app: after an update the old version and the download are removed, and a newer copy placed in Applications meanwhile is never replaced; started outside Applications, the app offers to move itself there.
- The dashboard opens with the profiles, all visible even in the smallest window, with how many are running next to their heading; Claude Code usage moves below what to check.
- Statistics draws every profile in its own color, the one of its icon.
- Simpler profile cards; a shortcut the system refused is said in words, with a Change button.
- Every section has the same frame and header; the sidebar puts Dashboard, Profiles and Statistics on top; Settings has an index of its groups.
- Fixed: two starts of the same profile at the same moment no longer open two instances on the same data folder; after Restart the new instance no longer shows as closing; the app and the command line can read the statistics at the same time; moving a removed profile's data to the Trash keeps every folder another profile uses and never reaches the standard Claude Desktop folder; shortcuts no longer stop working now and then; importing a configuration applies its settings at once.
- Also fixed: Logs no longer stays on "Loading…" and follows rotated logs without losing lines; "&" shows in the tray and the menu bar; the window could scroll past the content; every section opens at its top; the dashboard no longer shows "0 of 0" before its data arrives; event log warnings appear in the language of the app.
